senses.gloss:
[यु-थक् पृषो° दीर्ध] A herd, flock, multitude, a large number or troop (as of beasts); स्त्रीरत्नेषु ममोर्वशी प्रियतमा यूथे तवेयं वशा [[V. 4. 25]]; [[Ś. 5. 5.]] 
-Comp. 
-चारिन् a. going about in troops (as monkeys). 
-नाथः, -पः, -पतिः 
__1 the leader of a troop or band. 
__2 the head of a flock or herd (usually of elephants), a lordly elephant; मृगेन्द्रविक्रीडितयूथपा इव [[Bhāg. 4. 10. 20]]; गजयूथप यूथिकाशबलकेशी [[V. 4. 46.]] 
-परिभ्रष्ट a. fallen out from a herd. 
-बन्धः a flock, herd, troop. 
-मुख्यः the chief of a troop or herd (as of elephants &c.).

a. [यूथ-यत्] 
__1 Belonging to a troop or herd (at the end of comp.); सिंहेन क्रुद्धेन यथाश्वयूथ्या महाबला भीमबलेन तद्वत् [[Mb. 8. 89. 80.]] 
__2 Belonging to a herd or flock, being at the head of a herd. 
-थ्या A herd, flock.

यूथिका,
 
-यूथी A kind of jasmine or its flower; यूथिकाशबलकेशी [[V. 4. 46]]; [[Me. 26]]; [[Māl. 9. 15.]]
